messages:
sara: Quick sync — planning Q3 roadmap for Private deploy (VPC control plane, on‑prem packaging, airgap). Need to lock minimal launch scope and list of must-have security/integration asks from pilot customers. Proposed 3-phase plan attached (short bullets).
kevin: +1. Can we scope by customer category? fintech/healthcare have different blockers.
leila: We should call out installer formats explicitly: kube-helm chart, operator, and a plain VM bundle (rpm/deb + systemd). Packaging affects delivery time a lot.
omar: For air-gapped we need: signed images, offline install bundle, KMS/HSM integration option, and an attestable supply chain. FIPS request from Vault KMS is real.
sara: Agreed. Proposed minimal launch (MVP): VPC control plane (customer-managed networking), helm-based on-prem for k8s customers, offline tarball for appliance installs. No HSM in MVP (opt-in in phase 2). Thoughts?
jordan: UX note — installer should produce a single URL for the customer to ping for health + an ops panel token. Keep rollout simple.
maya: From sales feedback: bank pilot will push HSM/KMS + strict audit logs at launch. If we delay HSM, they'll want a workaround (bring-your-own-vault proxy).
kevin: Implementation constraints: VPC control plane depends on secure connector (mTLS) + token rotation. If we cut HSM from MVP, we can still support KMIP via proxy in phase 1.
leila: Packaging effort estimates (rough): helm chart + docs: 3 sprints; VM bundle + installer: 2 sprints; airgap bundle + validation infra: 2 sprints; HSM/KMS integration: 4 sprints. These can overlap.
sara: OK — tradeoff conversation: 1) Ship helm + VPC control plane + airgap tarball (no HSM) as MVP. 2) Parallel work to prototype KMS/HSM and VM appliance for specific pilots. 3) Phase 2 = HSM + hardened compliance. Vote? :thumbsup: for MVP as proposed.
omar: :thumbsup: but need clear launch criteria doc for security sign-off. I'll prepare a checklist.
jordan: +1 on checklist. Also add telemetry opt-out and minimal logs for compliance.
maya: Customer ask: offline eval image with 30-day license. Can we commit? Sales wants it for pilots.
kevin: We can do offline eval if we provide signed bundles and a short-lived license key system (no outbound calls). Adds ~1 sprint.
sara: Let's capture action items: 1) Omar to draft security launch checklist (due +3 days). 2) Leila to produce packaging timeline + owners (due EOD Fri). 3) Kevin to prototype KMS proxy for pilot (spike next week). 4) Jordan to spec installer UX and ops-token flow. 5) Maya to collect pilot customer must-haves and prioritize.
deploy-bot: NOTE: created ticket PROD-7890 "private-deploy-mvp-scope" assigned to sara.
sara: Thanks — we'll review checklist in next planning sync Wed 10am. If anyone has strong objections to removing HSM from MVP, speak now.
omar: No objections but will call out residual risk in checklist.
kevin: Fine by me. We should also document rollback/fallback: fallback to hosted model in case of failed on-prem inference (explicit opt-in).
sara: Good point — add fallback and SLA expectations to the public roadmap doc.
maya: I'll flag pilot customers that need SLA guarantees.
sara: End of thread: I'll update the roadmap doc and link to tickets. Thanks everyone.
